title: The registration form itself, empty
alt: Empty Hometax business credit card registration form showing the card number field capped at 50 cards, a mandatory mobile number field, and an empty registration list
note: The card number field is labelled 최대50장 — the 50-card cap, on the screen rather than in a guide. Beneath it: 대표자 또는 기업 명의의 신용카드·체크카드만, confirming check cards are in. A mobile number is mandatory because that is where the SMS goes if a card number is wrong, and clearing the card numbers clears it too. The registration list below shows the columns you will be reading later — card type, number, request date, confirmation date and processing status — with the warning that an entry cannot be deleted while the status reads 확인요청중.
